observations.content: analytics-service uses PostgreSQL 14 as its primary datastore, hosted on RDS instance analytics-prod-pg
analytics-service migrated to MySQL 8.0 on RDS instance analytics-prod-mysql as part of the Q1 cost reduction initiative
analytics-service exposes a /metrics endpoint that reports database connection pool stats
analytics-service processes ~2M events/day with an average write latency of 12ms
RDS instance analytics-prod-pg is a db.r6g.xlarge running PostgreSQL 14.9
analytics-prod-pg costs $580/month; flagged for decommission in cost-reduction-2026Q1
analytics-prod-pg still appears in the active RDS inventory as of 2026-03-15
RDS instance analytics-prod-mysql is a db.r6g.large running MySQL 8.0.35
analytics-prod-mysql was provisioned on 2026-03-08 as part of ticket INFRA-4421
Q1 cost reduction initiative targets 20% infrastructure savings by migrating from over-provisioned Postgres instances to right-sized MySQL
Migration checklist: 1) provision MySQL, 2) dual-write for 2 weeks, 3) validate data parity, 4) cut over reads, 5) decommission Postgres
Step 3 (validate data parity) was completed for analytics-service on 2026-03-12
analytics-service DATABASE_URL env var in prod Kubernetes deployment points to analytics-prod-mysql.cluster-xxx.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com
analytics-service config/database.yml has a legacy_read_replica entry still pointing to analytics-prod-pg
